name: SHIVAN SHARMA
title: ==SENIOR QA ENGINEER== · E2E AUTOMATION & QUALITY LEADERSHIP

sections.heading: PROFESSIONAL SUMMARY
sections.body: ==Senior QA Engineer== with **15+ years** of test automation and quality engineering expertise, specializing in ==building end-to-end automation suites== that accelerate release velocity. ==Led the transition from manual testing to automated frameworks==, growing automated coverage from **30% to 80%** and ==cutting regression-testing time by more than 70%==. Proven track record ==balancing thorough regression testing with fast-paced shipping== in agile environments.

roles.title: ==TEST AUTOMATION ENGINEER / ASSOCIATE CONSULTANT & TEST LEAD==
roles.meta: Jun 2018 – Present | Noida, India | Enterprise Web & API Platforms
bullets: ==Lead end-to-end QA lifecycle== — planning, estimation, execution, defect tracking, and reporting — across multiple releases.

==Architected Playwright/JavaScript-TypeScript automation suite with ~700+ test cases== for modern web applications, ==enabling daily regression runs== and ==cutting release-testing time by more than 70%==.
==Integrated Playwright and Selenium suites into Jenkins and GitHub Actions CI/CD pipelines==, serving as ==automated quality gatekeeper== for every pull request.
==Automated API testing== (SOAP UI, Postman) and ==validated backend data integrity via complex SQL Server/DB2 scripting== across multiple critical business workflows.
==Built structured defect management workflow==, ==transitioning team from ad-hoc spreadsheet tracking to organized Jira lifecycle==, improving defect resolution turnaround.
==Mentored team of 10+ QA engineers== on automation frameworks, best practices, and modern test-driven approaches.
